name: google-maps-scraper
title_zh: 本地 Docker 跑谷歌地图抓取
tagline_zh: 说一句「找柏林牙医」就开抓，商家名、邮箱、评分、评论全落本地表格。不用碰代码，Docker 装好就能盯进度。
tagline_en: Say "find dentists in Berlin" and it scrapes names, emails, ratings, reviews into a local sheet. No code—just.
desc_en: Find businesses, leads, emails, reviews, ratings, and contact details from Google Maps. Use for requests such as "find dentists in Berlin", "scrape Google Maps", "get local business leads", or "collect Google Maps reviews". Runs the open-source scraper locally with Docker and guides nontechnical users through setup, monitoring, and results.
why_zh: 把开源抓取器封装成向导式流程，非技术用户也能安全跑完，结果存本地不经过第三方云。
why_en: Wraps a powerful open-source scraper into a guided flow, so non-coders run it safely. Data stays local—no third-party cloud.
limit_zh: 只抓谷歌地图公开数据，不含街景或室内图。需要本机装 Docker 并保持联网；反爬严格时可能中断，需手动重试。
limit_en: Scrapes only public Maps data (no Street View/indoors). Requires Docker + internet; may stall under anti-bot pressure, needing manual retries. ~2000.
title_en: Local Google Maps scraper: emails, reviews, leads without.
